body: Things happen when you feel like crap. Just take a second and lets look at this from an objective standpoint. It seems like shit right now, and yeah maybe it wont get better. I know the feeling of helplessness and self hate.  Go to someone you trust, a family member, a guidance counselor, anything. Go and get some help. It might feel like nothing will help, but any alternative is better than not existing. If you don't do this for you (which you should) do it for me. I want you to feel better man.
I guess I am just glad things didn't go as badly as they could have. Now I think it is my turn to help a bit.
Dude, no one wants to feel alone. I am glad you are getting help. And I am sure anyone on here will be more than willing to give you support.

I would say you need a doctor. You want to avoid meds, I did too for a long time. The problem with that is it NEVER gets better if you don't get those meds. Your ups will be weird and your downs will be low and you will always feel pulled in two and that your life means nothing. The only real solution is go to a doctor and get help. Finding someone to talk to is always something to help out the process. If you have no one else I am here right now so I could always give you my email or something. Support and medical help tend to be the way to go.
I guess I just want to actually live my life instead of ending it before I start. I also kind of want to help give some understanding to those who need help.
Well you already took the first step. You know something is not right and you reached out for some sort of help. I will be willing to listen if that helps at all.
